versions.changelog: 补全展示名称/分类/触发词/功能介绍；description 中英结合增强触发

Initial release of wc-cover-studio – WeChat cover generator for official account articles:

- Generates production-ready covers (dual-use, wide, and square formats) from article files or topic descriptions.
- Automated workflow: reads article, chooses visual style, selects industry-specific imagery, generates 1:1 master image, overlays title, and applies post-processing.
- Ensures covers comply with WeChat’s cropping and safe zone rules.
- Built-in QA: verifies title placement and image integrity before delivery.
- Delivers all standard cover formats plus a cover explanation markdown for each article.
